start.speaker: Quartermaster Vessit
start.text: The board. Standing bounties on the left, matters of record on the right. I count what goes out. I count what comes back. The two numbers have never once agreed.

choices.text: You have counted me out a few times now.
Kell says the columns are the same column.
Who set the bounties before you?

record.speaker: Quartermaster Vessit
record.text: Things somebody wants brought back up. A name, a page, a person. I do not pay well for those. I pay honestly, which is rarer and worth less.

counted.speaker: Quartermaster Vessit
counted.text: Three times. I counted a hammer twice once, and then I stopped counting hammers. I have not yet stopped counting you.

kell.speaker: Quartermaster Vessit
kell.text: Kell is a clerk and clerks are right about arithmetic and wrong about everything the arithmetic is for. He is right about this one.

vessit_arc.speaker: Vessit
vessit_arc.text: The Chapter did, and the bounties were people. I set mine on things that were never anybody. It is a small distinction and I hold it very tightly.
